sentences.en: From The New York Times, this is The Interview.
sentences.zh: 这里是来自《纽约时报》的《访谈》节目。

sentences.en: I'm Lulu Garcia Navarro.
sentences.zh: 我是露露·加西亚-纳瓦罗。

sentences.en: J.B.
sentences.zh: J·B·

sentences.en: Pritzker has served as Illinois governor since 2019 and he's now running for a rare third term.
sentences.zh: 普利茨克自2019年起担任伊利诺伊州州长，他现在正在竞选罕见的第三任期。

sentences.en: During his time in office, Pritzker has become one of President Trump's main antagonists.
sentences.zh: 在他的任期内，普利茨克已经成为特朗普总统的主要政敌之一。

sentences.en: And for that reason, among others, many see him as a strong contender for the Democratic presidential nomination in 2028.
sentences.zh: 出于这个及其他原因，许多人认为他是2028年民主党总统提名的有力竞争者。

sentences.en: Even if he's not saying that yet.
sentences.zh: 尽管他现在还没有这么说。

sentences.en: A former businessman from one of America's wealthiest and most influential families, being a progressive billionaire is central to J.B.
sentences.zh: 作为出身美国最富裕、最具影响力家族之一的前商人，身为进步派亿万富翁是J·B·

sentences.en: Pritzker's political brand.
sentences.zh: 普利茨克政治品牌的核心。

sentences.en: But as anti-billionaire sentiment grows on the left, and not only on the left, so does a potential source of tension with voters.
sentences.zh: 但随着左翼（且不仅限于左翼）反亿万富翁情绪的高涨，与选民之间潜在的紧张关系也在增加。

sentences.en: I first sat down with Pritzker at the governor's mansion in Springfield, Illinois, earlier this month, as America's war in Iran continued to escalate
sentences.zh: 本月早些时候，当伊朗战争继续升级时，我首次在伊利诺伊州斯普林菲尔德的州长官邸采访了普利茨克

sentences.en: and on the heels of the first midterm primaries.
sentences.zh: 当时正值首轮中期选举初选刚刚结束。

sentences.en: I wanted to discuss both, but also power, wealth, and where he sees his party going.
sentences.zh: 我想讨论这两者，还有权力、财富，以及他认为他的政党将走向何方。

sentences.en: Here's my conversation with Governor J.B.
sentences.zh: 以下是我与州长J·B·

sentences.en: Pritzker.
sentences.zh: 普利茨克的对话。

sentences.en: Governor Pritzker, thank you so much for joining us.
sentences.zh: 普利茨克州长，非常感谢您接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: I'm really excited to have you on the interview.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴能邀请您参加《访谈》节目。

sentences.en: Great to be with you, Lulu.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能和你在一起，露露。

sentences.en: It's a bit of a gray day here in Springfield, Illinois, but we are at the governor's mansion, which is really impressive, very beautiful.
sentences.zh: 伊利诺伊州斯普林菲尔德今天的天气有点阴沉，但我们在州长官邸，这里真的很令人印象深刻，非常美丽。

sentences.en: Lots of Abraham Lincoln.
sentences.zh: 有很多亚伯拉罕·林肯的元素。

sentences.en: In fact, there's a bust over there of Abraham Lincoln.
sentences.zh: 事实上，那边就有一个亚伯拉罕·林肯的半身像。

sentences.en: Does it feel weird to have him sort of looming over you sometimes?
sentences.zh: 有时看着他仿佛高高在上地俯视着你，会不会觉得有点奇怪？

sentences.en: No, it's really wonderful, actually.
sentences.zh: 不，实际上感觉真的很棒。

sentences.en: I mean, to think about, you know, this is the state that produced the greatest president that we've ever had.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你想想，你知道，这个州培养了我们见过的最伟大的总统。

sentences.en: And a state that's produced other great presidents, too, like Barack Obama and Ulysses S.
sentences.zh: 这个州还培养了其他伟大的总统，比如巴拉克·奥巴马和尤利西斯·S·

sentences.en: Grant and Ronald Reagan.
sentences.zh: 格兰特以及罗纳德·里根。

sentences.en: So, you know, we're proud.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我们感到很自豪。

sentences.en: We've forgotten that he was born here.
sentences.zh: 我们都忘了他是出生在这里的。

sentences.en: Ronald Reagan.
sentences.zh: 罗纳德·里根。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It always seems such a product of California.
sentences.zh: 他总是显得那么具有加州特色。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: You know, there's a lot going on in the world, a lot going on in your state, but I want to start with more of a philosophical question.
sentences.zh: 你知道，世界上发生了很多事，你们州也发生了很多事，但我想从一个更偏哲学的问题开始。

sentences.en: When we look at this moment in this era, which is so dominated, obviously, by the president,
sentences.zh: 当我们审视这个时代时，这个时代显然由总统主导，

sentences.en: I've been really thinking about how he wields executive power.
sentences.zh: 我一直在思考他是如何行使行政权力的。

sentences.en: And I'm wondering what you think the lesson for Democrats is from President Trump and how he has wielded power to get what he wants.
sentences.zh: 我想知道您认为民主党人能从特朗普总统身上学到什么教训，以及他是如何运用权力来实现自己目标的。

sentences.en: I think it's a lesson for everyone that gets elected to office in an executive poSt.
sentences.zh: 我认为这对所有当选担任行政职务的人来说都是一个教训。

sentences.en: I think that what President Trump has done is, I think, operate like the president of a banana republic, or as if he were an authoritarian.
sentences.zh: 我认为特朗普总统所做的事情，就像香蕉共和国的总统一样，或者像一个独裁者一样运作。

sentences.en: That is, now he's got power.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，现在他有了权力。

sentences.en: Or he's going to vanquish his enemies and rule in favor of the people who will enrich him.
sentences.zh: 或者他要消灭他的敌人，并为那些能让他致富的人统治。

sentences.en: And I think that the lesson is for the country, that this is a dangerous road that we've gone down, putting someone like that in public office.
sentences.zh: 我认为给国家的教训是，把这样的人送上公职，我们走上了一条危险的道路。

sentences.en: We need to stand up against corruption.
sentences.zh: 我们需要挺身而出反对腐败。

sentences.en: We need to stand up and make sure that whoever it is that gets elected is someone who's good and decent and kind.
sentences.zh: 我们需要站出来，确保当选的无论是谁，都是一个善良、正派、仁慈的人。

sentences.en: I think kindness is something that's been missing in our politics.
sentences.zh: 我认为仁慈是我们政治中所缺失的东西。

sentences.en: So you could say that's a lesson for Democrats.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以说这对民主党人来说是一个教训。

sentences.en: I think it's a lesson for all elected officials.
sentences.zh: 我认为这对所有民选官员来说都是一个教训。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, you're sort of talking about overreach and ruling like an authoritarian, which is one version of looking at that.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道，你有点在谈论权力过大和像独裁者一样统治，这是看待这个问题的一种方式。

sentences.en: Another version, though, I think, is how he's really been able to push through an aggressive agenda.
sentences.zh: 不过，我认为另一种方式是看他是如何真正能够强行推进一项激进议程的。

sentences.en: You know, the shock and awe theory of governance, if you will.
sentences.zh: 如果你愿意的话，可以说是治理的“休克疗法”。

sentences.en: Um, I've heard so many voters complain, and I'm sure you've heard this too, about incrementalism, about, you know, all the promises that get made when you're running for office
sentences.zh: 嗯，我听到很多选民抱怨，我确信你也听到过，关于渐进主义，关于，你知道，竞选时做出的一切承诺

sentences.en: and then feeling like...
sentences.zh: 然后感觉...

sentences.en: I complain about it too.
sentences.zh: 我也在抱怨这个。

sentences.en: ...everything gets stymied once someone gets into office.
sentences.zh: ...一旦有人上台，一切都陷入了僵局。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I'm wondering if there are lessons to be taken from the frustration of voters and the way that he's managed to do it.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，从选民的沮丧感以及他成功做到这一点的方式中，是否可以吸取一些教训。

sentences.en: Yeah, let me begin by saying that I ran on an agenda as governor.
sentences.zh: 是的，首先我想说，我作为州长是以一套议程参加竞选的。

sentences.en: I ran on a very bold agenda, and I swiftly enacted that agenda.
sentences.zh: 我带着一个非常大胆的议程参选，并且迅速颁布了该议程。

sentences.en: And my first year in office really accomplished most of what I ran on, which were big things.
sentences.zh: 我上任的第一年实际上就完成了我竞选时承诺的大部分重大事项。

sentences.en: I think that is the way to operate, there's no doubt.
sentences.zh: 我认为这确实是运作的方式，毫无疑问。

sentences.en: And that we as Democrats, if there's a lesson, it's that there should be a Project 2029 for Democrats.
sentences.zh: 如果我们民主党人能吸取什么教训的话，那就是民主党应该有一个“2029计划”。

sentences.en: Now, remember, though, that Project 2025 also included taking away people's rights and freedoMs.
sentences.zh: 不过，请记住，“2025计划”还包括剥夺人们的权利和自由。

sentences.en: It included tearing down the safety net that holds up our working families and that stands up for the most vulnerable in our society.
sentences.zh: 它包括拆除支撑我们工薪家庭并支持我们社会中最弱势群体的安全网。

sentences.en: So there are things about the agenda that I think are...
sentences.zh: 所以关于这个议程有些事情我认为...

sentences.en: That obviously you don't agree with.
sentences.zh: 显然你是不同意的。

sentences.en: Not just that.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是那样。

sentences.en: I think they're reprehensible and they're anti-democratic.
sentences.zh: 我认为它们是应受谴责的，而且是反民主的。

sentences.en: But yes, the speed of the agenda.
sentences.zh: 但确实，议程推进的速度很快。

sentences.en: And it's not shock and awe so much as run on the agenda.
sentences.zh: 与其说是休克疗法，不如说是带着议程去竞选。

sentences.en: When you run and win on an agenda, you can accomplish that agenda and need to do it as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 当你带着一项议程竞选并获胜时，你就能完成该议程，并且需要尽快做到这一点。

sentences.en: The problem is Donald Trump would say things, and now he's doing things that are very different.
sentences.zh: 问题是唐纳德·特朗普会说一套，而现在他在做非常不同的事情。

sentences.en: Remember, he said, we're not going to cut Medicaid.
sentences.zh: 记住，他说过，我们不会削减医疗白卡。

sentences.en: That's precisely what he's done.
sentences.zh: 而这正是他所做的。

sentences.en: What does a Project 2029 agenda look like for you?
sentences.zh: 对你来说，“2029计划”的议程是什么样的？

sentences.en: I don't think you can speak of it in shorthand, but I'll just say a couple of things that I think are absolutely necessary.
sentences.zh: 我认为你不能用简短的话来概括它，但我只想说几件我认为绝对必要的事情。

sentences.en: One is we've got to restore the rule of law, and that means holding people accountable who've broken the law.
sentences.zh: 第一，我们必须恢复法治，这意味着要让打破法律的人承担责任。

sentences.en: I'm talking about in this administration, when we get a new one, the people in this administration who've broken the law and federal agents who've broken the law
sentences.zh: 我说的是在这届政府中，当我们迎来新政府时，这届政府中打破法律的人以及打破法律的联邦特工

sentences.en: need to be held accountable.
sentences.zh: 需要承担责任。

sentences.en: And that means criminally prosecuted.
sentences.zh: 这意味着受到刑事起诉。

sentences.en: Criminally prosecuted, civilly prosecuted, you know, whatever it is that we can do, right?
sentences.zh: 刑事起诉、民事起诉，你知道，任何我们能做的事，对吧？

sentences.en: It may be that you can't criminally prosecute somebody, but that you can go after them civilly.
sentences.zh: 可能你无法在刑事上起诉某人，但你可以通过民事手段追究他们的责任。

sentences.en: So that's one thing.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一回事。

sentences.en: But a second thing, just thinking about people's everyday lives, right?
sentences.zh: 但第二件事，想想人们的日常生活，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, just lifting people up and making things more affordable in the world.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就是振奋人们的精神，让世界上的东西更加买得起。

sentences.en: How about finally, finally, we Democrats get to universal healthcare.
sentences.zh: 我们民主党人为什么不最终、终于实现全民医疗呢？

sentences.en: Obamacare was terrific, and it advanced the cause.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马医改非常棒，它推动了这项事业。

sentences.en: But we still have a whole lot of people that don't have coverage.
sentences.zh: 但我们仍然有相当多的人没有医疗保险。

sentences.en: And now, of course, it's being taken away from a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 当然，现在它正在被从很多人身上剥夺。

sentences.en: So that's part of the agenda, universal healthcare.
sentences.zh: 所以这是议程的一部分，全民医疗。

sentences.en: Another part of the agenda is we've got to raise the minimum wage in this country.
sentences.zh: 议程的另一部分是，我们必须提高这个国家的最低工资。

sentences.en: You know, the minimum wage is $7.25.
sentences.zh: 你知道，最低工资是7.25美元。

sentences.en: It's about $14,000 a year.
sentences.zh: 大约是一年14,000美元。

sentences.en: If you have one full-time job, you can't survive on 14.
sentences.zh: 如果你有一份全职工作，你靠14,000美元是无法生存的。

sentences.en: As a single person, you can't.
sentences.zh: 作为一个单身人士，你做不到。

sentences.en: There's no place in the country.
sentences.zh: 全国没有哪个地方可以。

sentences.en: And even if you hold two minimum wage jobs,
sentences.zh: 即使你做两份最低工资的工作，

sentences.en: $28,000 a year, you can't raise a family on that.
sentences.zh: 一年28,000美元，你也无法靠这个养家糊口。

sentences.en: Maybe you could survive alone on that.
sentences.zh: 也许你一个人靠这个勉强能活。

sentences.en: So why are we allowing people to live at $7.25?
sentences.zh: 那我们为什么还要允许人们靠7.25美元生活呢？

sentences.en: By the way, the tipped wage in this country is about $2.20 an hour.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这个国家的小费工资大约是每小时2.20美元。

sentences.en: Ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 太荒谬了。

sentences.en: We need to raise wages in this country and start with the minimum wage.
sentences.zh: 我们需要提高这个国家的工资，从最低工资开始。

sentences.en: So I give that as an example because healthcare and people earning enough to live on, those seem like basic fundamentals of who we are as Democrats.
sentences.zh: 我举这个例子是因为医疗保健和让人们赚到足以生活的钱，这些似乎是我们作为民主党人的基本核心。

sentences.en: That ought to be right at the top of the agenda.
sentences.zh: 这应该排在议程的最顶端。

sentences.en: Why do you think there hasn't been a Project 2029
sentences.zh: 您认为为什么民主党人和他们的智库盟友没有提出“2029计划”

sentences.en: by the Democrats and their think tank allies, which is actually how Project 2025 came about from the right?
sentences.zh: 而“2025计划”实际上就是右翼通过这种方式出台的？

sentences.en: That was a concerted effort from many different groups to sort of enact it.
sentences.zh: 那是许多不同群体共同努力将其付诸实施的结果。

sentences.en: It's a great question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的问题。

sentences.en: And you talked about incrementalism earlier.
sentences.zh: 你刚才谈到了渐进主义。

sentences.en: I do think that people feel like, well, we need the public to come along on every issue.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为人们觉得，嗯，我们需要公众在每个问题上都跟我们走。

sentences.en: And so let's play them out over several years so that we can finally get consensus and so on.
sentences.zh: 所以让我们把它们拉长几年，以便我们最终达成共识等等。

sentences.en: It's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: But some of these issues have been around for an awful long time.
sentences.zh: 但其中一些问题已经存在很长时间了。

sentences.en: And I guarantee you that if you polled the American public about raising the minimum wage,
sentences.zh: 我向你保证，如果你就提高最低工资民调美国公众，

sentences.en: 80%, including a majority of Republicans, would say it's time to raise the minimum wage.
sentences.zh: 80%的人，包括多数共和党人，都会说现在是时候提高最低工资了。

sentences.en: So I don't think we need to be incrementalist about some things that I think are universally understood.
sentences.zh: 所以对于某些我认为普遍被理解的事情，我认为我们不需要采取渐进主义。

sentences.en: So as we're speaking, we have just had our first insight into the feeling of the voting public because we've had sort of our first primaries for the midterMs.
sentences.zh: 在我们交谈的同时，我们刚刚对投票公众的情绪有了初步了解，因为我们已经迎来了中期选举的第一轮初选。

sentences.en: And in particular, of course, the Texas Senate primary is being looked at very closely on both the left and the right.
sentences.zh: 特别是，当然，得克萨斯州参议院初选正受到左翼和右翼的高度关注。

sentences.en: James Tallarico defeated Jasmine Crockett.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·塔拉里科击败了贾丝明·克罗克特。

sentences.en: And that race was seen as something of a bellwether for the kind of approach that works best for Democrats.
sentences.zh: 这场竞选被视为对最适合民主党的方法的一种风向标。

sentences.en: And I'm just wondering what your takeaways from that were.
sentences.zh: 我只是想知道你从中得到了什么启示。

sentences.en: If you look across the last five or so elections, if you include Spanberger's election in Virginia and Mikey Sherrill's election in New Jersey
sentences.zh: 如果你回顾过去五次左右的选举，包括弗吉尼亚州的斯潘伯格选举、新泽西州的米基·谢里尔选举

sentences.en: and Mamdani's election in New York City, and as you said, the primary in Texas, as well as the election or nomination of Roy Cooper in North Carolina,
sentences.zh: 以及纽约市的马姆达尼选举，正如你所说，得克萨斯州的初选，还有罗伊·库珀在北卡罗来纳州的选举或提名，

sentences.en: they've run on an affordability agenda.
sentences.zh: 他们的竞选都是围绕可负担性议程展开的。

sentences.en: They've run on making sure that working people understand we Democrats are the ones who are fighting for them, not the other guys.
sentences.zh: 他们的竞选核心是确保劳动人民明白我们民主党人才是为他们而战的人，而不是其他人。

sentences.en: Now, I know that what you're asking me is, oh, the split in the, is there a split in the Democratic Party and one side or another, you know, has now won.
sentences.zh: 现在，我知道你问我的是，哦，民主党内部是否存在分裂，其中某一方现在已经赢了。

sentences.en: But the truth is that both of these candidates, what they exhibited,
sentences.zh: 但事实是这两位候选人所展现出来的，
